files.rationale: Modify the PUT and DELETE endpoints to support dummy data operations for editing and deleting notes when no database connection is available

summary: The Item Notes feature needs to be modified to fully support dummy data operations for all CRUD operations. The main route.ts already has dummy data fallback logic for GET and POST, but the [id]/route.ts file only works with MongoDB for PUT and DELETE. This plan modifies the [id]/route.ts file to include dummy data fallback logic for PUT and DELETE operations, ensuring all operations work with dummy data as requested in the revision comment.
